sources.snippet: CrossEncoder based on Qwen/Qwen3.5-.8B This is a Cross Encoder model finetuned from Qwen/Qwen3.5-.8B on the image_to_text and text_to_image datasets using the sentence-transformers library. It computes scores for pairs of texts, which can be used for text reranking and semantic search. sources.snippet: Qwen3-Reranker # 1 Introduction # The Qwen3 Reranker model series is the latest proprietary model of the Qwen family, specifically designed for text embedding and ranking tasks. Building upon the dense foundational models of the Qwen3 series, it provides a comprehensive range of text embeddings and reranking models in various sizes (0.6B, 4B, and 8B).
